issue: GEM holds Ukraine LNG Terminal (Yuzhnyi/Pivdennyi Port, Odesa Oblast) as cancelled (inferred 4y, 2021). There has been recurring REVIVAL activity at the same site that a reviewer may want to track against this record rather than as a brand-new terminal: (a) reports of Nov-2024 agreements with Excelerate Energy and a Spanish gas company for a Pivdennyi FSRU (possible 2026 launch) [single secondary source]; (b) D.Trading-Venture Global LNG supply HOA (June 2025, offtake not a terminal); (c) President Zelenskyy's 19-20 Oct 2025 pitch to the White House of a two-phase Odesa LNG terminal (~15 bcm/y, FSRU then onshore). As of Oct 2025 the latest iteration is described as effectively cancelled/stalled (no FID, no financing, requires Turkey/Bosphorus transit agreement). Does NOT meet the add-bar; logged to monitor_list.
suggested_action: Keep cancelled for now. Monitor the Yuzhnyi/Pivdennyi FSRU revival (Excelerate / Odesa) and, if it reaches FID or a firm sponsor+charter, decide whether to revive this record or add a new terminal. See monitor entry.
